title: Center Letterheads and Envelopes
slide_intent: Show how a local center identifies itself within a common correspondence system. The recipient should see both the agency and the location responsible for the letter.
strategic_value: NASA can make a center-specific sender legible while retaining the national signature and standard government stationery sizes.
demonstration: The Goddard Space Flight Center letterhead and envelope pair the agency identity with the center’s name and Maryland address. The letterhead places the black logotype apart from the sender block.
practical_value: Use the center example to arrange a local sender address and the NASA mark across letterhead and envelope while retaining the specified type roles.

content_islands.name: Formats and type
content_islands.spec: Set the title and short specifications across the upper band. Include the 5/16-inch logotype cap height with the corresponding type guidance.

content_islands.name: Center letterhead
content_islands.spec: Place the center and address block at the upper left and the logotype at the upper right of the outlined page. Keep the reply line and open writing area below.

content_islands.name: Center envelope
content_islands.spec: Set the wide envelope beneath the letter, with the return address at left, the mark next to it and the postal indicia at right.
